name: evalSPMF_bind_comm
statement:
theorem evalSPMF_bind_comm {α β γ : Type} (oa : ProbComp α) (ob : ProbComp β)
    (k : α → β → ProbComp γ) :
    𝒮[oa >>= fun a => ob >>= fun b => k a b] = 𝒮[ob >>= fun b => oa >>= fun a => k a b]
proof:
:= by
  refine SPMF.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [show 𝒮[oa >>= fun a => ob >>= fun b => k a b] x
        = Pr[= x | oa >>= fun a => ob >>= fun b => k a b] from (probOutput_def _ _).symm,
    show 𝒮[ob >>= fun b => oa >>= fun a => k a b] x
        = Pr[= x | ob >>= fun b => oa >>= fun a => k a b] from (probOutput_def _ _).symm]
  rw [probOutput_bind_eq_tsum]
  rw [show (∑' a : α, Pr[= a | oa] * Pr[= x | ob >>= fun b => k a b])
      = ∑' (a : α) (b : β), Pr[= a | oa] * (Pr[= b | ob] * Pr[= x | k a b]) from
    tsum_congr fun a => by rw [probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]]
  rw [probOutput_bind_eq_tsum]
  rw [show (∑' b : β, Pr[= b | ob] * Pr[= x | oa >>= fun a => k a b])
      = ∑' (b : β) (a : α), Pr[= b | ob] * (Pr[= a | oa] * Pr[= x | k a b]) from
    tsum_congr fun b => by rw [probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
  exact tsum_congr fun a => tsum_congr fun b => by ring

name: evalSPMF_bind_const_neverFails
statement:
theorem evalSPMF_bind_const_neverFails {α γ : Type} (od : ProbComp α) (hmass : Pr[⊥ | od] = 0)
    (k : ProbComp γ) : 𝒮[od >>= fun _ => k] = 𝒮[k]
proof:
:= by
  refine SPMF.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [show 𝒮[od >>= fun _ => k] x = Pr[= x | od >>= fun _ => k] from (probOutput_def _ _).symm,
    show 𝒮[k] x = Pr[= x | k] from (probOutput_def _ _).symm]
  rw [probOutput_bind_const, hmass]; simp

name: evalSPMF_bind_congr_left
statement:
theorem evalSPMF_bind_congr_left {α β : Type} (oa : ProbComp α) (f g : α → ProbComp β)
    (h : ∀ a, 𝒮[f a] = 𝒮[g a]) : 𝒮[oa >>= f] = 𝒮[oa >>= g]
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalSPMF_bind, evalSPMF_bind]; exact congrArg _ (funext h)

name: tsum_count_eq_length
statement:
lemma tsum_count_eq_length {C : Type} [DecidableEq C] (rl : List C) :
    (∑' rc : C, (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞)) = (rl.length : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  induction rl with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a rl ih =>
      have hsplit : ∀ rc : C,
          ((a :: rl).count rc : ℝ≥0∞) = (if rc = a then 1 else 0) + (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        intro rc; rw [List.count_cons]; by_cases h : rc = a
        · subst h; simp [add_comm]
        · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
      simp_rw [hsplit]
      rw [ENNReal.tsum_add, ih, List.length_cons, tsum_ite_eq]
      push_cast; ring

name: tsum_probOutput_fresh_mul_count_le
statement:
lemma tsum_probOutput_fresh_mul_count_le {C P : Type} [DecidableEq C]
    (oa : ProbComp (C × P)) (rl : List C) (ε : ℝ)
    (hGuess : ∀ cm : C, Pr[= cm | Prod.fst <$> oa] ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    (∑' w : C × P, Pr[= w | oa] * (rl.count w.1 : ℝ≥0∞))
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * (rl.length : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : ∀ w : C × P,
      ((rl.count w.1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)
        = ∑' rc : C, (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0) := by
    intro w; rw [tsum_eq_single w.1 (fun rc hrc => by simp [Ne.symm hrc])]; simp
  simp_rw [hcount]
  rw [show (∑' w : C × P, Pr[= w | oa] *
        ∑' rc : C, (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0))
      = ∑' rc : C, ∑' w : C × P,
          Pr[= w | oa] * ((rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0)) from by
    rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]; exact tsum_congr fun w => by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]]
  have hmarg : ∀ rc : C,
      (∑' w : C × P, Pr[= w | oa] * ((rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0)))
        = (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * Pr[= rc | Prod.fst <$> oa] := by
    intro rc
    rw [show Pr[= rc | Prod.fst <$> oa]
          = ∑' w : C × P, Pr[= w | oa] * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0) from by
      rw [probOutput_map_eq_tsum]; refine tsum_congr fun w => ?_
      simp only [eq_comm]; split <;> rename_i h <;> simp [h]]
    rw [show (∑' w : C × P,
            Pr[= w | oa] * ((rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0)))
          = ∑' w : C × P,
              (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * (Pr[= w | oa] * (if w.1 = rc then 1 else 0)) from
      tsum_congr fun w => by ring]
    rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
  simp_rw [hmarg]
  calc (∑' rc : C, (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * Pr[= rc | Prod.fst <$> oa])
      ≤ ∑' rc : C, (rl.count rc : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun rc => by gcongr; exact hGuess rc
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ε * (rl.length : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, mul_comm, tsum_count_eq_length]

name: Factorizes.bind
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Factorizes, evalSPMF_bind] at h ⊢
  rw [h, bind_assoc]

name: evalSPMF_step_commute_tape
statement:
theorem evalSPMF_step_commute_tape {γ S Ans τ ρ : Type}
    (step : ProbComp (Ans × S)) (tape : ProbComp τ)
    (proj : γ × ρ → γ × S)
    (defCont : Ans → S → ProbComp (γ × S))
    (tapeCont : Ans → S × τ → ProbComp (γ × ρ))
    (hcont : ∀ (a : Ans) (s' : S),
      𝒮[defCont a s'] = 𝒮[tape >>= fun t => proj <$> tapeCont a (s', t)]) :
    𝒮[step >>= fun p => defCont p.1 p.2] =
      𝒮[tape >>= fun t =>
          proj <$>
            (((fun p : Ans × S => (p.1, (p.2, t))) <$> step) >>= fun p => tapeCont p.1 p.2)]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [evalSPMF_bind_congr_left step (fun p => defCont p.1 p.2)
    (fun p => tape >>= fun t => proj <$> tapeCont p.1 (p.2, t)) (fun p => hcont p.1 p.2)]
  rw [evalSPMF_bind_comm step tape (fun p t => proj <$> tapeCont p.1 (p.2, t))]
  refine evalSPMF_bind_congr_left tape _ _ (fun t => ?_)
  rw [bind_map_left, map_bind]

name: tsum_probOutput_simulateQ_run_mul_of_rel
statement:
theorem tsum_probOutput_simulateQ_run_mul_of_rel
    {ι : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι} {σ : Type}
    (impl : QueryImpl spec (StateT σ ProbComp))
    {γ : Type} (oa : OracleComp spec γ)
    (Rel : σ → σ → Prop)
    (hstep : ∀ (t : spec.Domain) (s₁ s₂ : σ), Rel s₁ s₂ →
      ∀ (K : spec.Range t → σ → ℝ≥0∞),
        (∀ (b : spec.Range t) (t₁ t₂ : σ), Rel t₁ t₂ → K b t₁ = K b t₂) →
        (∑' p : spec.Range t × σ, Pr[= p | (impl t).run s₁] * K p.1 p.2)
          = ∑' p : spec.Range t × σ, Pr[= p | (impl t).run s₂] * K p.1 p.2) :
    ∀ (F : γ → σ → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ (g : γ) (s₁ s₂ : σ), Rel s₁ s₂ → F g s₁ = F g s₂) →
      ∀ (s₁ s₂ : σ), Rel s₁ s₂ →
        (∑' z : γ × σ, Pr[= z | (simulateQ impl oa).run s₁] * F z.1 z.2)
          = ∑' z : γ × σ, Pr[= z | (simulateQ impl oa).run s₂] * F z.1 z.2
proof:
:= by
  induction oa using OracleComp.inductionOn with
  | pure a =>
      intro F hF s₁ s₂ hs
      simp only [simulateQ_pure, StateT.run_pure, tsum_probOutput_pure_mul]
      exact hF a s₁ s₂ hs
  | query_bind t ob ih =>
      intro F hF s₁ s₂ hs
      simp only [simulateQ_bind, simulateQ_spec_query, StateT.run_bind, tsum_probOutput_bind_mul]
      set K : spec.Range t → σ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun b u =>
        ∑' z : γ × σ, Pr[= z | (simulateQ impl (ob b)).run u] * F z.1 z.2 with hK
      have hKinv : ∀ (b : spec.Range t) (t₁ t₂ : σ), Rel t₁ t₂ → K b t₁ = K b t₂ :=
        fun b t₁ t₂ ht => ih b F hF t₁ t₂ ht
      exact hstep t s₁ s₂ hs K hKinv

name: readMany_true_iff
statement:
theorem readMany_true_iff (w : R) (q : ℕ) (σ : List Bool → R) :
    readMany w q σ = true ↔ ∃ j < q, w = σ (List.replicate j false)
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing σ with
  | zero => simp [readMany]
  | succ q ih =>
    rw [readMany]
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos q, by simpa using h.symm⟩
      · by_cases hhead : σ [] = w
        · exact ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos q, hhead.symm⟩
        · rw [decide_eq_false (by simpa using hhead)] at h
          obtain ⟨j, hj, hwj⟩ := (ih (fun h => σ (false :: h))).1 h
          exact ⟨j + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hj, by simpa [List.replicate_succ] using hwj⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, hwj⟩
      cases j with
      | zero => left; simpa using hwj.symm
      | succ j =>
        by_cases hhead : σ [] = w
        · exact Or.inl hhead
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          rw [decide_eq_false (by simpa using hhead)]
          exact (ih (fun h => σ (false :: h))).2
            ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj, by simpa [List.replicate_succ] using hwj⟩

name: probEvent_hiddenReadMany_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [hiddenReadMany, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
  have hstep : ∀ w : R,
      Pr[= w | oa] * Pr[(fun b => b = true) | (pure (readMany w q σ) : ProbComp Bool)]
        ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
            if w = σ (List.replicate j false) then Pr[= w | oa] else 0 := by
    intro w
    by_cases hfire : readMany w q σ = true
    · rw [probEvent_pure]
      simp only [hfire, if_true, mul_one]
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hwj⟩ := (readMany_true_iff w q σ).1 hfire
      calc Pr[= w | oa]
          = (if w = σ (List.replicate j false) then Pr[= w | oa] else 0) := by rw [if_pos hwj]
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
              if w = σ (List.replicate j false) then Pr[= w | oa] else 0 :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun j => if w = σ (List.replicate j false) then Pr[= w | oa] else 0)
              (fun i _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_range.2 hj)
    · rw [probEvent_pure, if_neg hfire, mul_zero]
      exact zero_le
  refine le_trans (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hstep) ?_
  rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun _ _ => ENNReal.summable)]
  calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∑' w : R,
          (if w = σ (List.replicate j false) then Pr[= w | oa] else 0)
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ε := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
        rw [tsum_eq_single (σ (List.replicate j false))
          (by intro b hb; rw [if_neg hb])]
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        exact hε _
    _ = (q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: readManyList_true_iff
statement:
theorem readManyList_true_iff (ws : List R) (q : ℕ) (σ : List Bool → R) :
    readManyList ws q σ = true ↔ ∃ w ∈ ws, readMany w q σ = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [readManyList, List.any_eq_true]

name: probEvent_bind_const_or_pure
statement:
theorem probEvent_bind_const_or_pure (q : Bool) (mb : ProbComp Bool) :
    Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | mb >>= fun b => pure (q || b)]
      ≤ Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | (pure q : ProbComp Bool)]
        + Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | mb]
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | true => simp
  | false => simp

name: probEvent_hiddenReadList_le
statement:
theorem probEvent_hiddenReadList_le {oa : ProbComp R} {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ∀ r : R, Pr[= r | oa] ≤ ε)
    (q : ℕ) (σ : List Bool → R) (n : ℕ) :
    Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | hiddenReadList oa q σ n] ≤ (n : ℝ≥0∞) * ((q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hiddenReadList]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [hiddenReadList, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
    have hsplit : ∀ w : R,
        Pr[= w | oa] * Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) |
            hiddenReadList oa q σ n >>= fun b => pure (readMany w q σ || b)]
          ≤ Pr[= w | oa] * Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | (pure (readMany w q σ) : ProbComp Bool)]
            + Pr[= w | oa] * Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | hiddenReadList oa q σ n] := by
      intro w
      rw [← mul_add]
      gcongr
      exact probEvent_bind_const_or_pure (readMany w q σ) (hiddenReadList oa q σ n)
    refine le_trans (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hsplit) ?_
    rw [ENNReal.tsum_add]
    have h1 : (∑' w : R, Pr[= w | oa] *
        Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | (pure (readMany w q σ) : ProbComp Bool)])
        = Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | hiddenReadMany oa q σ] := by
      rw [hiddenReadMany, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
    have h2 : (∑' w : R, Pr[= w | oa] *
        Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | hiddenReadList oa q σ n])
        ≤ Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | hiddenReadList oa q σ n] := by
      rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left zero_le tsum_probOutput_le_one
    rw [h1]
    calc Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | hiddenReadMany oa q σ]
          + (∑' w : R, Pr[= w | oa] *
              Pr[(fun c : Bool => c = true) | hiddenReadList oa q σ n])
        ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε + (n : ℝ≥0∞) * ((q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε) :=
          add_le_add (probEvent_hiddenReadMany_le hε q σ) (le_trans h2 ih)
      _ = (↑(n + 1) : ℝ≥0∞) * ((q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε) := by push_cast; ring

name: probEvent_bind_hiddenReadList_le
statement:
theorem probEvent_bind_hiddenReadList_le {oa : ProbComp R} {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hε : ∀ r : R, Pr[= r | oa] ≤ ε) (q : ℕ) (σ : List Bool → R) (kn : ProbComp ℕ) :
    Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | kn >>= fun n => hiddenReadList oa q σ n]
      ≤ (∑' n : ℕ, Pr[= n | kn] * (n : ℝ≥0∞)) * ((q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => ?_
  rw [mul_assoc]
  gcongr
  exact probEvent_hiddenReadList_le hε q σ n

name: probEvent_le_of_eq_bind_hiddenReadList
statement:
theorem probEvent_le_of_eq_bind_hiddenReadList {β : Type} {run : ProbComp β} {bad : β → Prop}
    {oa : ProbComp R} {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ∀ r : R, Pr[= r | oa] ≤ ε)
    (q : ℕ) (σ : List Bool → R) (kn : ProbComp ℕ)
    (hfac : Pr[bad | run]
      ≤ Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | kn >>= fun n => hiddenReadList oa q σ n]) :
    Pr[bad | run] ≤ (∑' n : ℕ, Pr[= n | kn] * (n : ℝ≥0∞)) * ((q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε)
proof:
:=
  hfac.trans (probEvent_bind_hiddenReadList_le hε q σ kn)

name: probEvent_bind_fire_eq_defer
statement:
theorem probEvent_bind_fire_eq_defer {α : Type} (oa : ProbComp R)
    (q : ℕ) (gen : ProbComp (α × (List Bool → R))) (k : R → ProbComp (α × Bool))
    (hk : ∀ w : R, k w = gen >>= fun p => pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2)) :
    Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) | oa >>= k]
      = Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) |
          gen >>= fun p => oa >>= fun w =>
            (pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2) : ProbComp (α × Bool))]
proof:
:= by
  have hL : Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) | oa >>= k]
      = ∑' (w : R) (p : α × (List Bool → R)),
          Pr[= w | oa] * (Pr[= p | gen] *
            Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) |
              (pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2) : ProbComp (α × Bool))]) := by
    rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
    refine tsum_congr fun w => ?_
    rw [hk w, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
  have hR : Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) |
          gen >>= fun p => oa >>= fun w =>
            (pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2) : ProbComp (α × Bool))]
      = ∑' (p : α × (List Bool → R)) (w : R),
          Pr[= p | gen] * (Pr[= w | oa] *
            Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) |
              (pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2) : ProbComp (α × Bool))]) := by
    rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
    refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
    rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
  rw [hL, hR, ENNReal.tsum_comm]
  refine tsum_congr fun p => tsum_congr fun w => ?_
  ring

name: probEvent_bind_fire_le_of_gen
statement:
theorem probEvent_bind_fire_le_of_gen {α : Type} {oa : ProbComp R} {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hε : ∀ r : R, Pr[= r | oa] ≤ ε) (q : ℕ) (gen : ProbComp (α × (List Bool → R)))
    (k : R → ProbComp (α × Bool))
    (hk : ∀ w : R, k w = gen >>= fun p => pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2)) :
    Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) | oa >>= k] ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_bind_fire_eq_defer oa q gen k hk]
  refine probEvent_bind_le_of_forall_le fun p _ => ?_
  have hinner : Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) |
        oa >>= fun w => (pure (p.1, readMany w q p.2) : ProbComp (α × Bool))]
      = Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | hiddenReadMany oa q p.2] := by
    rw [hiddenReadMany, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
    refine tsum_congr fun w => ?_
    rw [probEvent_pure, probEvent_pure]
  rw [hinner]
  exact probEvent_hiddenReadMany_le hε q p.2

name: probEvent_bind_fire_le_of_marginal_eq_readMany
statement:
theorem probEvent_bind_fire_le_of_marginal_eq_readMany {α : Type} {oa : ProbComp R} {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hε : ∀ r : R, Pr[= r | oa] ≤ ε) (q : ℕ) (σ : List Bool → R) (k : R → ProbComp (α × Bool))
    (hmarg : ∀ w : R, Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) | k w]
      = Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | (pure (readMany w q σ) : ProbComp Bool)]) :
    Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) | oa >>= k] ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) * ε
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr : Pr[(fun z : α × Bool => z.2 = true) | oa >>= k]
      = Pr[(fun b : Bool => b = true) | hiddenReadMany oa q σ] := by
    rw [hiddenReadMany, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
    exact tsum_congr fun w => by rw [hmarg w]
  rw [hcongr]
  exact probEvent_hiddenReadMany_le hε q σ

statement:

name: isProbabilityMeasure_denote_liftBind
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_denote_liftBind [MeasurableSpace α] (a : P.A)
    (cont : P.B a → FreeM P α)
    (hMeasurable : AEMeasurable (fun b => denote (cont b)) (IsMeasureSpec.toMeasure a))

name: isProbabilityMeasure_denote
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_denote [MeasurableSpace α] (program : FreeM P α) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (denote program)
proof:
:= by
  induction program with
  | pure _ => exact ⟨by simp⟩
  | lift_bind a cont ih =>
      exact isProbabilityMeasure_denote_liftBind a cont
        Measurable.of_discrete.aemeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ih)

name: denote_bind
statement:
theorem denote_bind [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (program : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β)
    (hf : Measurable fun x => denote (f x)) :
    denote (FreeM.bind program f) = Measure.bind (denote program) fun x => denote (f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction program with
  | pure x => simpa using (Measure.dirac_bind hf x).symm
  | lift_bind a cont ih =>
      change Measure.bind (IsMeasureSpec.toMeasure a) (fun b => denote (FreeM.bind (cont b) f))
          = Measure.bind (Measure.bind (IsMeasureSpec.toMeasure a) fun b => denote (cont b))
              fun x => denote (f x)
      rw [Measure.bind_bind (Measurable.of_discrete).aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable]
      exact Measure.bind_congr_right (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun b => ih b)

name: denote_bind_of_discrete
statement:
theorem denote_bind_of_discrete [MeasurableSpace α] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] (program : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β) :
    denote (FreeM.bind program f) = Measure.bind (denote program) fun x => denote (f x)
proof:
:=
  denote_bind program f Measurable.of_discrete

name: denote_map_of_measurable
statement:
theorem denote_map_of_measurable [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (program : FreeM P α) (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) :
    denote (FreeM.map f program) = (denote program).map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← FreeM.bind_pure_comp f program, denote_bind program (pure ∘ f)]
  · simpa only [Function.comp_apply, denote_pure] using
      Measure.bind_dirac_eq_map (denote program) hf
  · change Measurable (Measure.dirac ∘ f)
    exact Measure.measurable_dirac.comp hf

name: denote_map_of_discrete
statement:
theorem denote_map_of_discrete [MeasurableSpace α] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] (program : FreeM P α) (f : α → β) :
    denote (FreeM.map f program) = (denote program).map f
proof:
:=
  denote_map_of_measurable program f Measurable.of_discrete

name: denote_bind_bind_prod_mk_eq_prod
statement:
theorem denote_bind_bind_prod_mk_eq_prod [MeasurableSpace α] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] (left : FreeM P α) (right : FreeM P β) :
    denote (FreeM.bind left fun x =>
      FreeM.bind right fun y => pure (x, y)) =
        (denote left).prod (denote right)
proof:
:= by
  rw [denote_bind_of_discrete left, Measure.prod]
  exact Measure.bind_congr_right (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    change denote (FreeM.bind right fun y => pure (x, y)) =
      Measure.map (Prod.mk x) (denote right)
    rw [denote_bind right (fun y => pure (x, y))]
    · simpa only [denote_pure] using
        Measure.bind_dirac_eq_map (denote right) (by fun_prop)
    · change Measurable (Measure.dirac ∘ Prod.mk x)
      exact Measure.measurable_dirac.comp (by fun_prop))

name: denoteKernel_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denoteKernel_apply (f : α → FreeM P β) (x : α) :
    denoteKernel f x = denote (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: denote_bind_eq_comp
statement:
theorem denote_bind_eq_comp (program : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β) :
    denote (program >>= f) = denoteKernel f ∘ₘ denote program
proof:
:=
  denote_bind_of_discrete program f

name: denote_map
statement:
theorem denote_map (g : α → β) (program : FreeM P α) :
    denote (g <$> program) = (denote program).map g
proof:
:= by
  change denote (FreeM.map g program) = (denote program).map g
  exact denote_map_of_discrete program g

name: klDiv_denote_bind_le
statement:
theorem klDiv_denote_bind_le (mx my : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β) :
    klDiv (denote (mx >>= f)) (denote (my >>= f)) ≤ klDiv (denote mx) (denote my)
proof:
:= by
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_denote (P := P) mx
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_denote (P := P) my
  rw [denote_bind_eq_comp, denote_bind_eq_comp]
  exact klDiv_comp_right_le _ _ (denoteKernel f)

name: klDiv_denote_map_le
statement:
theorem klDiv_denote_map_le (g : α → β) (mx my : FreeM P α) :
    klDiv (denote (g <$> mx)) (denote (g <$> my)) ≤ klDiv (denote mx) (denote my)
proof:
:= by
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_denote (P := P) mx
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_denote (P := P) my
  rw [denote_map, denote_map]
  exact klDiv_map_le _ _ Measurable.of_discrete

private lemma toSPMF'_apply_eq [MonadLiftT m PMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m PMF]

proof:

  refine (tsum_eq_single (Except.ok x) fun y hy => ?_).trans ?_
  · cases y with

name: probFailure_eq
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probFailure_eq (mx : ExceptT ε m α) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx] = Pr[⊥ | mx.run] +
      Pr[ (fun r => match r with | Except.error _ => True | Except.ok _ => False) | mx.run]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [probFailure_def, probEvent_eq_tsum_indicator, probOutput_def]
  rw [show 𝒮[mx] = ((liftM mx.run : SPMF _) >>= fun r =>
      match r with | Except.ok a => pure a | Except.error _ => failure : SPMF α) from rfl]
  simp only [SPMF.run_eq_toPMF, SPMF.toPMF_bind, Option.elimM, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
    PMF.bind_apply, ENNReal.summable, tsum_option, Option.elim_none, PMF.pure_apply, ↓reduceIte,
    mul_one, Option.elim_some, evalSPMF_def, SPMF.apply_eq_toPMF_some, ne_eq, PMF.apply_ne_top,
    not_false_eq_true, add_right_inj_of_ne_top]
  refine tsum_congr fun r => ?_
  cases r <;> simp

name: probOutput_liftM

name: probOutput_seq_eq_tsum
statement:
lemma probOutput_seq_eq_tsum (mf : m (α → β)) (mx : m α) (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | mf <*> mx] =
      ∑' f, ∑' x, Pr[= f | mf] * Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[= y | (pure (f x) : m β)]
proof:
:= by
  simp [seq_eq_bind_map, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, probOutput_map_eq_tsum,
    ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, mul_assoc]

    (mf : m (α → β)) (mx : m α) (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | mf <*> mx] =
      ∑' f, ∑' x, if y = f x then Pr[= f | mf] * Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [seq_eq_bind_map, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum,
    probOutput_map_eq_tsum_ite, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]

    Pr[ p | mf <*> mx] = ∑' f, Pr[= f | mf] * Pr[ p ∘ f | mx]

  simp only [seq_eq_bind_map, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, probEvent_map]

statement:
lemma probEvent_seq_eq_tsum_ite (mf : m (α → β)) (mx : m α)
    (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Pr[ p | mf <*> mx] = ∑' (f : α → β) (x : α),
      if p (f x) then Pr[= f | mf] * Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [probEvent_seq_eq_tsum, probEvent_eq_tsum_ite, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left,
    Function.comp_apply, mul_ite, mul_zero]

name: probFailure_seq
statement:

lemma probFailure_seq (mf : m (α → β)) (mx : m α) :
    Pr[⊥ | mf <*> mx] = Pr[⊥ | mf] + Pr[⊥ | mx] - Pr[⊥ | mf] * Pr[⊥ | mx]

proof:
:= by
  rw [seqLeft_eq, Set.ext_iff]; aesop

name: evalSPMF_seqLeft
statement:
@[grind norm]
lemma evalSPMF_seqLeft (mx : m α) (my : m β) :
    𝒮[mx <* my] = 𝒮[mx] <* 𝒮[my]
proof:
:= by
  simp [seqLeft_eq]

name: probOutput_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp, grind =_]
lemma probOutput_seqLeft (mx : m α) (my : m β) (x : α) :
    Pr[= x | mx <* my] = (1 - Pr[⊥ | my]) * Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [seqLeft_eq, seq_eq_bind_map, map_eq_bind_pure_comp, bind_assoc]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, pure_bind, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum]
  simp_rw [show ∀ a : α, Pr[= x | (Function.const β a <$> my : m α)] =
    (1 - Pr[⊥ | my]) * Pr[= x | (pure a : m α)] from fun a => probOutput_map_const my a x,
    mul_left_comm _ (1 - Pr[⊥ | my])]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ← probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, bind_pure]

name: probFailure_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp, grind =_]
lemma probFailure_seqLeft (mx : m α) (my : m β) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx <* my] = Pr[⊥ | mx] + Pr[⊥ | my] - Pr[⊥ | mx] * Pr[⊥ | my]
proof:
:= by
  rw [seqLeft_eq, probFailure_seq, probFailure_map]

name: probEvent_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp, grind =_]
lemma probEvent_seqLeft (mx : m α) (my : m β) (p : α → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | mx <* my] = (1 - Pr[⊥ | my]) * Pr[ p | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [seqLeft_eq, seq_eq_bind_map, map_eq_bind_pure_comp, bind_assoc]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, pure_bind, probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
  simp_rw [show ∀ a : α, Pr[ p | (Function.const β a <$> my : m α)] =
    (1 - Pr[⊥ | my]) * Pr[ p | (pure a : m α)] from fun a => probEvent_map_const my a p,
    mul_left_comm _ (1 - Pr[⊥ | my])]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ← probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, bind_pure]

name: support_seqRight
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_seqRight (mx : m α) (my : m β) [Decidable (support mx).Nonempty] :
    support (mx *> my) = if (support mx).Nonempty then support my else ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [seqRight_eq, Set.ext_iff]; aesop

name: evalSPMF_seqRight
statement:
@[grind norm]
lemma evalSPMF_seqRight (mx : m α) (my : m β) :
    𝒮[mx *> my] = 𝒮[mx] *> 𝒮[my]
proof:
:= by
  simp [seqRight_eq]

name: probOutput_seqRight
statement:
@[simp, grind =_]
lemma probOutput_seqRight (mx : m α) (my : m β) (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | mx *> my] = (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * Pr[= y | my]
proof:
:= by
  simp [seqRight_eq, seq_eq_bind_map, probOutput_bind_const]

name: probFailure_seqRight
statement:
@[simp, grind =_]
lemma probFailure_seqRight (mx : m α) (my : m β) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx *> my] = Pr[⊥ | mx] + Pr[⊥ | my] - Pr[⊥ | mx] * Pr[⊥ | my]
proof:
:= by
  rw [seqRight_eq, probFailure_seq, probFailure_map]

name: probEvent_seqRight
statement:
@[simp, grind =_]
lemma probEvent_seqRight (mx : m α) (my : m β) (p : β → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | mx *> my] = (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * Pr[ p | my]
proof:
:= by
  simp [seqRight_eq, seq_eq_bind_map, probEvent_bind_const]

name: support_seq_map_eq_image2
statement:
lemma support_seq_map_eq_image2 :
    support (f <$> mx <*> my) = Set.image2 f (support mx) (support my)
proof:
:= by
  ext z; simp [seq_eq_bind_map, Set.mem_image2]

name: finSupport_seq_map_eq_image2
statement:
@[simp low + 1]
lemma finSupport_seq_map_eq_image2 [HasEvalFinset m]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] :
    finSupport (f <$> mx <*> my) = Finset.image₂ f (finSupport mx) (finSupport my)
proof:
:= by
  ext z; simp [seq_eq_bind_map, Finset.mem_image₂]

name: evalSPMF_seq_map
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_seq_map :
    𝒮[f <$> mx <*> my] = f <$> 𝒮[mx] <*> 𝒮[my]
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalSPMF_seq, evalSPMF_map]

name: probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum
statement:
lemma probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum (z : γ) :
    Pr[= z | f <$> mx <*> my] = ∑' (x : α) (y : β),
      Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[= y | my] * Pr[= z | (pure (f x y) : m γ)]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monad_norm, Function.comp,
    probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, mul_assoc]

name: probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum_ite
statement:
lemma probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum_ite [DecidableEq γ] (z : γ) :
    Pr[= z | f <$> mx <*> my] =
      ∑' (x : α) (y : β), if z = f x y then Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[= y | my] else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum, probOutput_pure, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: probOutput_seq_map_eq_mul_of_injective2
statement:
lemma probOutput_seq_map_eq_mul_of_injective2 (hf : f.Injective2) (x : α) (y : β) :
    Pr[= f x y | f <$> mx <*> my] = Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[= y | my]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum]
  simp only [probOutput_pure_eq_indicator, Set.indicator, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  refine (tsum_eq_single x fun x' hx' => ?_).trans ?_
  · exact ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mpr fun b => if_neg fun h' => hx' (hf h').1.symm
  · refine (tsum_eq_single y fun y' hy' => ?_).trans ?_
    · exact if_neg fun h' => hy' (hf h').2.symm
    · simp

name: probOutput_seq_map_swap
statement:
lemma probOutput_seq_map_swap (z : γ) :
    Pr[= z | Function.swap f <$> my <*> mx] = Pr[= z | f <$> mx <*> my]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [probOutput_seq_map_eq_tsum, Function.swap]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
  exact tsum_congr fun x' => tsum_congr fun y' => by ring

name: evalSPMF_seq_map_swap
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_seq_map_swap :
    𝒮[Function.swap f <$> my <*> mx] = 𝒮[f <$> mx <*> my]
proof:
:=
  evalSPMF_ext (probOutput_seq_map_swap mx my f)

name: probEvent_seq_map_swap
statement:
lemma probEvent_seq_map_swap (p : γ → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | Function.swap f <$> my <*> mx] = Pr[ p | f <$> mx <*> my]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [probEvent_eq_tsum_indicator, probOutput_seq_map_swap]

name: probEvent_seq_map_eq_probEvent_comp_uncurry
statement:
lemma probEvent_seq_map_eq_probEvent_comp_uncurry (p : γ → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | f <$> mx <*> my] = Pr[ p ∘ Function.uncurry f | Prod.mk <$> mx <*> my]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← probEvent_map]
  congr 1
  rw [map_seq, Functor.map_map]
  rfl

name: probEvent_seq_map_eq_probEvent
statement:
lemma probEvent_seq_map_eq_probEvent (p : γ → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | f <$> mx <*> my] = Pr[ fun z => p (f z.1 z.2) | Prod.mk <$> mx <*> my]
proof:
:=
  probEvent_seq_map_eq_probEvent_comp_uncurry mx my f p

name: mem_support_seq_map_iff_of_injective2
statement:
lemma mem_support_seq_map_iff_of_injective2 (hf : f.Injective2) (x : α) (y : β) :
    f x y ∈ support (f <$> mx <*> my) ↔ x ∈ support mx ∧ y ∈ support my
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_seq_map_eq_image2, Set.mem_image2_iff hf]

name: mem_finSupport_seq_map_iff_of_injective2
statement:
lemma mem_finSupport_seq_map_iff_of_injective2 [HasEvalFinset m]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (hf : f.Injective2) (x : α) (y : β) :
    f x y ∈ finSupport (f <$> mx <*> my) ↔ x ∈ finSupport mx ∧ y ∈ finSupport my
proof:
:= by
  rw [finSupport_seq_map_eq_image2, Finset.mem_image₂_iff hf]

name: support_seq_map_swap
statement:
lemma support_seq_map_swap :
    support (Function.swap f <$> my <*> mx) = support (f <$> mx <*> my)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [support_seq_map_eq_image2, Set.image2_swap f]

name: finSupport_seq_map_swap
statement:
lemma finSupport_seq_map_swap [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq γ] :
    finSupport (Function.swap f <$> my <*> mx) = finSupport (f <$> mx <*> my)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finSupport_seq_map_eq_image2, Finset.image₂_swap f]

name: probEvent_seq_map_eq_mul
statement:
lemma probEvent_seq_map_eq_mul (p : γ → Prop) (q1 : α → Prop) (q2 : β → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, ∀ y ∈ support my, p (f x y) ↔ q1 x ∧ q2 y) :
    Pr[ p | f <$> mx <*> my] = Pr[ q1 | mx] * Pr[ q2 | my]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show f <$> mx <*> my = mx >>= fun x => f x <$> my by simp [seq_eq_bind_map]]
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
  simp only [probEvent_map]
  suffices hs : ∀ x, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[ p ∘ f x | my] =
      (if q1 x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0) * Pr[ q2 | my] by
    trans (∑' x, (if q1 x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0) * Pr[ q2 | my])
    · exact tsum_congr hs
    · rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]; symm; rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
  · by_cases hq : q1 x
    · simp only [if_pos hq]; congr 1
      exact probEvent_ext fun y hy => (h x hx y hy).trans (by simp [hq])
    · simp only [if_neg hq, zero_mul]
      rw [probEvent_eq_zero fun y hy => by
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, h x hx y hy]; simp [hq], mul_zero]
  · simp [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx]

name: probOutput_seq_map_eq_mul
statement:
lemma probOutput_seq_map_eq_mul (x : α) (y : β) (z : γ)
    (h : ∀ x' ∈ support mx, ∀ y' ∈ support my, z = f x' y' ↔ x' = x ∧ y' = y) :
    Pr[= z | f <$> mx <*> my] = Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[= y | my]
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput] using probEvent_seq_map_eq_mul mx my f
    (· = z) (· = x) (· = y) fun x' hx' y' hy' => eq_comm.trans (h x' hx' y' hy')

name: support_map
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma support_map [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonad m]
    (f : α → β) (mx : m α) :
    support (f <$> mx) = f '' support mx
proof:
:= by
  aesop (add simp monad_norm)

name: finSupport_map
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma finSupport_map [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM] [HasEvalFinset m] [LawfulMonad m]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (f : α → β) (mx : m α) : finSupport (f <$> mx) = (finSupport mx).image f
proof:
:= by
  grind [map_eq_bind_pure_comp]

name: evalSPMF_map
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma evalSPMF_map [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonad m]
    (mx : m α) (f : α → β) :
    𝒮[f <$> mx] = f <$> (𝒮[mx])
proof: := by simp [monad_norm]

name: evalSPMF_map_eq_of_evalSPMF_eq
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_map_eq_of_evalSPMF_eq [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonad m]
    {mx my : m α} (h : 𝒮[mx] = 𝒮[my]) (f : α → β) :
    𝒮[f <$> mx] = 𝒮[f <$> my]
proof:
:= by
  simpa [evalSPMF_map] using congrArg (fun p => f <$> p) h

name: probOutput_map_eq_of_evalSPMF_eq
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_of_evalSPMF_eq [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonad m]
    {mx my : m α} (h : 𝒮[mx] = 𝒮[my]) (f : α → β) (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[= y | f <$> my]
proof:
:=
  evalSPMF_ext_iff.mp (evalSPMF_map_eq_of_evalSPMF_eq h f) y

name: evalSPMF_comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma evalSPMF_comp_map [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonad m] (mx : m α) :
    evalSPMF ∘ (fun f => f <$> mx) = fun f : (α → β) => f <$> 𝒮[mx]
proof: := by aesop

name: probEvent_bind_pure_comp
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma probEvent_bind_pure_comp (q : β → Prop) :
    Pr[ q | mx >>= pure ∘ f] = Pr[ q ∘ f | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred q
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, probEvent_pure, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: probOutput_map_eq_tsum_subtype
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_tsum_subtype [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m] (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑' x : {x ∈ support mx | y = f x}, Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_eq_bind_pure_comp, tsum_subtype _, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, Function.comp_apply,
    Set.indicator, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  refine tsum_congr fun x => ?_
  by_cases hy : y = f x <;> by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx <;>
    simp [hy, hx, probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support]

name: probOutput_map_eq_tsum
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_tsum (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[= y | (pure (f x) : m β)]
proof:
:= by
  simp [monad_norm, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum]

name: probOutput_map_eq_tsum_subtype_ite
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_tsum_subtype_ite [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m] [DecidableEq β] (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑' x : support mx, if y = f x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_eq_bind_pure_comp, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum_subtype, Function.comp_apply,
    probOutput_pure, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: probOutput_map_eq_tsum_ite
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_tsum_ite [DecidableEq β] (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑' x : α, if y = f x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_eq_bind_pure_comp, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, Function.comp_apply, probOutput_pure,
    mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: probOutput_map_eq_sum_fintype_ite
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_sum_fintype_ite [Fintype α] [DecidableEq β] (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑ x : α, if y = f x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:=
  (probOutput_map_eq_tsum_ite mx f y).trans (tsum_eq_sum' <|
    by simp only [Finset.coe_univ, Set.subset_univ])

name: probOutput_map_eq_sum_finSupport_ite
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_sum_finSupport_ite [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m] [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (y : β) : Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑ x ∈ finSupport mx, if y = f x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:=
  (probOutput_map_eq_tsum_ite mx f y).trans (tsum_eq_sum' <|
    by simp only [coe_finSupport, Function.support_subset_iff, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff,
      probOutput_eq_zero_iff', mem_finSupport_iff_mem_support, Classical.not_imp, not_not, and_imp,
      imp_self, implies_true])

name: probOutput_map_eq_sum_filter_finSupport
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_sum_filter_finSupport [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m] [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (y : β) : Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = ∑ x ∈ (finSupport mx).filter (y = f ·), Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, probOutput_map_eq_sum_finSupport_ite]

name: probFailure_map
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma probFailure_map : Pr[⊥ | f <$> mx] = Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof:
:= by
  simp [monad_norm, probFailure_bind_eq_add_tsum]

name: probEvent_map
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma probEvent_map (q : β → Prop) : Pr[ q | f <$> mx] = Pr[ q ∘ f | mx]
proof:
:= by
  grind [= map_eq_bind_pure_comp]

name: probOutput_map
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probOutput_map (y : β) : Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[ fun x => f x = y | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using probEvent_map mx f (· = y)

name: probEvent_comp
statement: lemma probEvent_comp (q : β → Prop) : Pr[ q ∘ f | mx] = Pr[ q | f <$> mx]
proof:
:=
  symm <| probEvent_map mx f q

name: probFailure_eq_sub_sum_probOutput_map
statement:
lemma probFailure_eq_sub_sum_probOutput_map [Fintype β] (mx : m α) (f : α → β) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx] = 1 - ∑ y : β, Pr[= y | f <$> mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← probFailure_map (f := f), probFailure_eq_sub_tsum, tsum_fintype]

name: probOutput_map_eq_single
statement:
@[aesop unsafe apply]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_single [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {f : α → β} {y : β}
    (x : α) (h : ∀ x' ∈ support mx, y = f x' → x = x') (h' : f x = y) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probOutput_map_eq_tsum]
  refine (tsum_eq_single x fun x' hx' => ?_).trans (by rw [h', probOutput_pure_self, mul_one])
  specialize h x'
  by_cases hx' : x' ∈ support mx
  · simp only [mul_eq_zero]
    aesop
  · simp [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx']

name: support_map_const
statement:
@[aesop safe norm, grind .]
lemma support_map_const [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM]
    (hx : (support mx).Nonempty) :
    support ((fun _ => y) <$> mx) = {y}
proof:
:= by
  aesop

name: finSupport_map_const
statement:
@[grind .]
lemma finSupport_map_const [MonadLiftT m SetM] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SetM]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [HasEvalFinset m]
    (hx : (finSupport mx).Nonempty) : finSupport ((fun _ => y) <$> mx) =
      if (finSupport mx).Nonempty then {y} else ∅
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: probOutput_map_const
statement:
@[simp, aesop safe norm, grind =_]
lemma probOutput_map_const [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m] (y' : β) :
    Pr[= y' | (fun _ => y) <$> mx] =
      (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * Pr[= y' | (pure y : m β)]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monad_norm, Function.comp_def, probOutput_bind_const]

name: probEvent_map_const
statement:
@[aesop safe norm, grind =_]
lemma probEvent_map_const [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m] (p : β → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | (fun _ => y) <$> mx] =
      (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * Pr[ p | (pure y : m β)]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monad_norm, Function.comp_def, probEvent_bind_const]

name: probEvent_map_const'
statement:
@[aesop safe norm]
lemma probEvent_map_const' [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m] (p : β → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] :
    Pr[ p | (fun _ => y) <$> mx] =
      if p y then (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Function.comp_def]

name: probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_of_leftInvOn
statement:
@[aesop unsafe norm]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_of_leftInvOn
    (hr : Set.LeftInvOn g f (support mx)) (hy : f (g y) = y) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[= g y | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probOutput_map_eq_tsum]
  refine (tsum_eq_single (g y) fun x hx => ?_).trans (by aesop)
  by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
  · specialize hr hx
    aesop
  · aesop

name: probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_inverse
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_inverse
    (hl : Function.LeftInverse g f) (hy : f (g y) = y) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[= g y | mx]
proof: := by aesop

name: probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_apply
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_apply
    (hl : f (g y) = y) (hr : ∀ y, g (f y) = y) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[= g y | mx]
proof: := by aesop

name: probOutput_map_equiv
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma probOutput_map_equiv (e : α ≃ β) (mx : m α) (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | e <$> mx] = Pr[= e.symm y | mx]
proof: := by aesop

name: probOutput_map_injective
statement:
@[grind .]
lemma probOutput_map_injective (mx : m α) {f : α → β} (hf : f.Injective) (x : α) :
    Pr[= f x | f <$> mx] = Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [map_eq_bind_pure_comp, probOutput_bind_eq_tsum]
  refine (tsum_eq_single x fun y hy => ?_).trans (by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, probOutput_pure_self, mul_one])
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, probOutput_pure, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  exact if_neg fun h => hy (hf h.symm)

name: probOutput_map_eq_probOutput
statement:
lemma probOutput_map_eq_probOutput (mx : m α)
    {f : α → β} (hf : ∀ x x', f x = f x' → x = x') (x : α) :
    Pr[= f x | f <$> mx] = Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:=
  probOutput_map_injective mx hf x

name: probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_invFunOn
statement:
@[aesop unsafe norm]
lemma probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_invFunOn [Nonempty α]
    (mx : m α) {f : α → β} (hf : Set.InjOn f (support mx))
    (y : β) (hy : ∃ x ∈ support mx, f x = y) :
    Pr[= y | f <$> mx] = Pr[= Function.invFunOn f (support mx) y | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probOutput_map_eq_probOutput_of_leftInvOn]
  · intro x hx
    have h : ∃ y ∈ support mx, f y = f x := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    specialize hf (Classical.choose_spec h).1 hx (Classical.choose_spec h).2
    rw [Function.invFunOn]
    aesop
  rw [Function.invFunOn, dif_pos hy, (Classical.choose_spec hy).2]

name: probEvent_bind_le_add_of_disagree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue, probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue]
  calc expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | my x])
      ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x] + (if D x then 1 else 0) + ε₂) := by
        gcongr with x hx
        by_cases hDx : D x
        · simp only [if_pos hDx]
          exact probEvent_le_one.trans (le_add_right (le_add_left le_rfl))
        · simp only [if_neg hDx, add_zero]; exact h x hx hDx
    _ = expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x]) + Pr[ D | mx]
          + expectedValue mx (fun _ => ε₂) := by
        rw [expectedValue_add, expectedValue_add, expectedValue_ite_one]
    _ ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x]) + ε₁ + ε₂ := by
        gcongr
        exact expectedValue_le_of_le mx fun _ => le_rfl

name: probEvent_bind_le_add_bad_of_disagree
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue, probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue,
    probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue]
  calc expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | my x])
      ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x] + Pr[ r | ob x] + ε) := by
        gcongr with x hx
        by_cases hDx : D x
        · rw [hbad x hx hDx]
          exact probEvent_le_one.trans (le_add_right (le_add_left le_rfl))
        · exact (h x hx hDx).trans (add_le_add (le_add_right le_rfl) le_rfl)
    _ = expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x]) + expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ r | ob x])
          + expectedValue mx (fun _ => ε) := by
        rw [expectedValue_add, expectedValue_add]
    _ ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x]) + expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ r | ob x])
          + ε := by
        gcongr
        exact expectedValue_le_of_le mx fun _ => le_rfl

          + expectedValue mx (fun _ => ε) := by

    _ ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x]) + expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ r | ob x])
          + ε := by

name: probEvent_bind_le_add_bad_disagree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue, probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue,
    probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue]
  calc expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | my x])
      ≤ expectedValue mx
          (fun x => Pr[ q | oc x] + Pr[ r | ob x] + (if D x then 1 else 0) + ε₂) := by
        gcongr with x hx
        by_cases hDx : D x
        · simp only [if_pos hDx]

          + ε₁ + ε₂ := by

name: probFailure_bind_eq_add_tsum_support

lemma probFailure_bind_eq_add_tsum_support [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]

name: probOutput_bind_eq_tsum_subtype

name: probEvent_bind_le_probEvent
statement:
lemma probEvent_bind_le_probEvent [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]
    [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {my : α → m β} {q : β → Prop} {p : α → Prop}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, ¬ p x → Pr[ q | my x] = 0) :
    Pr[ q | mx >>= my] ≤ Pr[ p | mx]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue, ← expectedValue_ite_one]
  gcongr with x hx
  by_cases hp : p x
  · simp only [if_pos hp]; exact probEvent_le_one
  · simp only [if_neg hp, h x hx hp, le_refl]

name: probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_mul
statement:
lemma probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_mul [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]
    [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {my : α → m β} {q : β → Prop} {p : α → Prop} {ε : ENNReal}
    (hle : ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x → Pr[ q | my x] ≤ ε)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ support mx, ¬ p x → Pr[ q | my x] = 0) :
    Pr[ q | mx >>= my] ≤ Pr[ p | mx] * ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue, ← expectedValue_ite_one, ← expectedValue_mul_const]
  gcongr with x hx
  by_cases hp : p x
  · simp only [if_pos hp, one_mul]; exact hle x hx hp
  · simp only [if_neg hp, zero_mul, hzero x hx hp, le_refl]

name: probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_div
statement:
lemma probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_div [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]
    [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {my : α → m β} {q : β → Prop} {p : α → Prop} {c : ENNReal}
    (hle : ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x → Pr[ q | my x] ≤ c⁻¹)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ support mx, ¬ p x → Pr[ q | my x] = 0) :
    Pr[ q | mx >>= my] ≤ Pr[ p | mx] / c
proof:
:= by
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_mul hle hzero

name: probEvent_le_add_of_imp_or
statement:
lemma probEvent_le_add_of_imp_or [MonadLiftT m SPMF]
    [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {p q r : α → Prop}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x → q x ∨ r x) :
    Pr[ p | mx] ≤ Pr[ q | mx] + Pr[ r | mx]
proof:
:=
  (probEvent_mono h).trans (probEvent_or_le mx q r)

name: probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_add
statement:
lemma probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_add [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]
    [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {my : α → m β} {q : β → Prop} {p : α → Prop} {ε : ENNReal}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, ¬ p x → Pr[ q | my x] ≤ ε) :
    Pr[ q | mx >>= my] ≤ Pr[ p | mx] + ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue]
  calc expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | my x])
      ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => (if p x then 1 else 0) + ε) := by
        gcongr with x hx
        by_cases hp : p x
        · simp only [if_pos hp]; exact probEvent_le_one.trans le_self_add
        · simp only [if_neg hp, zero_add]; exact h x hx hp
    _ = Pr[ p | mx] + expectedValue mx (fun _ => ε) := by
        rw [expectedValue_add, expectedValue_ite_one]
    _ ≤ Pr[ p | mx] + ε := by
        gcongr
        exact expectedValue_le_of_le mx fun _ => le_rfl

name: probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_convex
statement:
lemma probEvent_bind_le_probEvent_convex [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]
    [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    {mx : m α} {my : α → m β} {q : β → Prop} {p : α → Prop} {ε : ENNReal}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, ¬ p x → Pr[ q | my x] ≤ ε) :
    Pr[ q | mx >>= my] ≤ Pr[ p | mx] + (1 - Pr[ p | mx]) * ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_expectedValue]
  calc expectedValue mx (fun x => Pr[ q | my x])
      ≤ expectedValue mx (fun x => (if p x then 1 else 0) + (if ¬ p x then 1 else 0) * ε) := by
        gcongr with x hx
        by_cases hp : p x
        · simp only [if_pos hp, if_neg (not_not_intro hp), zero_mul, add_zero]
          exact probEvent_le_one
        · simp only [if_neg hp, if_pos hp, zero_add, one_mul]; exact h x hx hp
    _ = Pr[ p | mx] + Pr[ fun x => ¬ p x | mx] * ε := by
        rw [expectedValue_add, expectedValue_mul_const, expectedValue_ite_one,
          expectedValue_ite_one]
    _ ≤ Pr[ p | mx] + (1 - Pr[ p | mx]) * ε := by
        gcongr
        exact ENNReal.le_sub_of_add_le_left probEvent_ne_top
          ((probEvent_compl mx p).trans_le tsub_le_self)

name: probFailure_bind_of_const
statement:
lemma probFailure_bind_of_const
    {mx : m α} {my : α → m β} {r : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, Pr[⊥ | my x] = r) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx >>= my] = Pr[⊥ | mx] + r * (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx])
proof:
:= by
  calc Pr[⊥ | mx >>= my]
    _ = Pr[⊥ | mx] + ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[⊥ | my x] := by grind
    _ = Pr[⊥ | mx] + ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] * r := by grind
    _ = Pr[⊥ | mx] + r * (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) := by
      rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, mul_comm, tsum_support_probOutput_eq_sub]

name: probFailure_bind_of_const'

    Pr[⊥ | mx >>= my] = Pr[⊥ | mx] + r - Pr[⊥ | mx] * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [probFailure_bind_of_const h, ENNReal.mul_sub, AddLECancellable.add_tsub_assoc_of_le,
    mul_comm Pr[⊥ | mx] r, mul_one] <;> simp [hr, ENNReal.mul_eq_top]

statement:

name: probFailure_bind_eq_sub_mul
statement:
lemma probFailure_bind_eq_sub_mul
    (mx : m α) (my : α → m β) (r : ℝ≥0∞) (hr : r ≠ ⊤) (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, Pr[⊥ | my x] = r) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx >>= my] = 1 - (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * (1 - r)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (support mx).eq_empty_or_nonempty with h' | ⟨x, hx⟩
  · rw [probFailure_bind_of_const' hr h, probFailure_eq_one h']
    simp [ENNReal.add_sub_cancel_right hr]
  · rw [probFailure_bind_of_const' hr h,
      ENNReal.one_sub_one_sub_mul_one_sub (by simp) (h x hx ▸ probFailure_le_one)]

name: probFailure_bind_le_add_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  calc Pr[⊥ | mx >>= my]
    _ = Pr[⊥ | mx] + ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[⊥ | my x] := by
      rw [probFailure_bind_eq_add_tsum_support]
    _ ≤ Pr[⊥ | mx] + ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] * r := by
      gcongr with x
      exact hr x.1 x.2
    _ ≤ Pr[⊥ | mx] + (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * r := by simp [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]

name: probFailure_bind_le_of_forall'
proof:
:= by
  rw [probFailure_bind_eq_add_tsum_support]
  refine add_le_add (le_of_eq h') ?_
  calc ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[⊥ | my x]
    _ ≤ ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] * r :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => mul_le_mul' le_rfl (hr x hx)
    _ = (1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]) * r := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, tsum_support_probOutput_eq_sub]
    _ = (1 - s) * r := by rw [h']
    _ ≤ 1 * r := mul_le_mul' tsub_le_self le_rfl
    _ = r := one_mul r

name: probFailure_bind_le_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  refine (probFailure_bind_le_add_of_forall hr).trans (by simp [h'])

    simp only [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
    by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
    · rw [← left_distrib]
      exact mul_le_mul' le_rfl
        ((add_le_add (h x hx) le_rfl).trans_eq (tsub_add_cancel_of_le (h' x hx)))
    · simp [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx]
  exact (ENNReal.cancel_of_ne probEvent_ne_top).le_tsub_of_add_le_right hadd

  rw [tsub_le_iff_right, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
  · rw [← left_distrib]

name: probEvent_bind_congr_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  simp only [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]

  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx

name: probEvent_bind_le_add
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
  calc ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[ fun y => ¬q y | my x]
      ≤ ∑' x, (Pr[= x | mx] * ε₂ + if ¬p x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0) := by
        refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
        by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
        · by_cases hp : p x
          · rw [if_neg (not_not_intro hp), add_zero]
            exact mul_le_mul' le_rfl (h₂ x hx hp)
          · rw [if_pos hp]
            exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le probEvent_le_one).trans le_add_self
        · simp [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx]
    _ = (∑' x, Pr[= x | mx]) * ε₂ + Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] := by
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]
    _ ≤ 1 * ε₂ + ε₁ := add_le_add (mul_le_mul' tsum_probOutput_le_one le_rfl) h₁
    _ = ε₁ + ε₂ := by ring

name: probEvent_bind_congr_le_add
proof:
:= by
  simp only [probEvent_bind_eq_tsum]
  calc ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[ q | my x]
      ≤ ∑' x, (Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[ q | oc x] + Pr[= x | mx] * ε) := by
        refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
        by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
        · exact (mul_le_mul' le_rfl (h x hx)).trans_eq (left_distrib ..)
        · simp [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx]
    _ ≤ (∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * Pr[ q | oc x]) + ε := by
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
        gcongr
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left zero_le tsum_probOutput_le_one

name: probEvent_compl_le_of_one_sub_le
statement:
lemma probEvent_compl_le_of_one_sub_le
    {mx : m α} {p : α → Prop} {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hfail : Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0)
    (h : 1 - ε ≤ Pr[ p | mx]) :
    Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] + Pr[ p | mx] = 1 := by
    simpa [hfail, add_comm] using probEvent_compl mx p
  rwa [ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq probEvent_ne_top hsum, tsub_le_iff_tsub_le]

name: probEvent_one_sub_le_of_compl_le
statement:
lemma probEvent_one_sub_le_of_compl_le
    {mx : m α} {p : α → Prop} {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hfail : Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0)
    (h : Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] ≤ ε) :
    1 - ε ≤ Pr[ p | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Pr[ p | mx] + Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] = 1 := by
    simpa [hfail] using probEvent_compl mx p
  rw [ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq probEvent_ne_top hsum]
  exact tsub_le_tsub_left h _

name: probEvent_exists_finset_le_sum
statement:
lemma probEvent_exists_finset_le_sum
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (mx : m α) (E : ι → α → Prop) :
    Pr[ (fun x => ∃ i ∈ s, E i x) | mx] ≤ Finset.sum s (fun i => Pr[ E i | mx])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on s (by simp) fun a s ha ih => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, show (fun x => ∃ i ∈ insert a s, E i x)
      = (fun x => E a x ∨ ∃ i ∈ s, E i x) by simp]
  refine (probEvent_or_le mx (E a) _).trans ?_
  gcongr

proof:

  simp_rw [probOutput_bind_eq_tsum, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]

  simp_rw [mul_assoc, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]

    ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * (∑ i ∈ s, f i x) = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * f i x
proof:

  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun _ _ => ENNReal.summable

name: tsum_probOutput_mul_of_const_on_support
statement:
lemma tsum_probOutput_mul_of_const_on_support [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    (mx : m α) {c : ℝ≥0∞}
    {F : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hconst : ∀ z ∈ support mx, F z = c) (hmass : Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0) :
    ∑' z, Pr[= z | mx] * F z = c

  change expectedValue mx F = c
  rw [expectedValue_congr_of_support hconst]
  rw [expectedValue_def, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, tsum_probOutput_eq_one' hmass, one_mul]

lemma probEvent_eq_tsum_subtype [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | mx] = ∑' x : {x | p x}, Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_indicator, tsum_subtype]

name: probEvent_eq_sum_filter_univ
statement:
lemma probEvent_eq_sum_filter_univ [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [Fintype α]
    (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Pr[ p | mx] = ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter p, Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_sum_fintype_ite, Finset.sum_filter]

name: probEvent_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma probEvent_eq_zero_iff :
    Pr[ p | mx] = 0 ↔ ∀ x ∈ support mx, ¬ p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_indicator]; aesop

name: probEvent_eq_zero_iff'
statement:
lemma probEvent_eq_zero_iff' [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :
    Pr[ p | mx] = 0 ↔ ∀ x ∈ finSupport mx, ¬ p x
proof: := by grind [probEvent_eq_zero_iff]

name: probEvent_ne_zero_iff
statement: lemma probEvent_ne_zero_iff : Pr[ p | mx] ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x ∈ support mx, p x
proof:
:= by
  grind [probEvent_eq_zero_iff]

name: probEvent_ne_zero_iff'
statement:
lemma probEvent_ne_zero_iff' [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :
    Pr[ p | mx] ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x ∈ finSupport mx, p x
proof: := by aesop

name: probEvent_pos_iff
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma probEvent_pos_iff : 0 < Pr[ p | mx] ↔ ∃ x ∈ support mx, p x
proof:
:= by
  simp [pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: probEvent_pos_iff'
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probEvent_pos_iff' [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :
    0 < Pr[ p | mx] ↔ ∃ x ∈ finSupport mx, p x
proof: := by grind [probEvent_pos_iff]

name: probEvent_ne_zero_iff_nonempty
statement:
lemma probEvent_ne_zero_iff_nonempty :
    Pr[ p | mx] ≠ 0 ↔ {x ∈ support mx | p x}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_ne_zero_iff]; simp [Set.nonempty_def]

name: probEvent_eq_zero_iff_not_nonempty
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probEvent_eq_zero_iff_not_nonempty :
    Pr[ p | mx] = 0 ↔ ¬ {x ∈ support mx | p x}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_zero_iff]
  simp [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]

name: probEvent_eq_tsum_subtype_mem_support
statement:
lemma probEvent_eq_tsum_subtype_mem_support (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | mx] = ∑' x : {x ∈ support mx | p x}, Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_subtype, tsum_subtype, tsum_subtype, ← support_probOutput,
    ← Set.indicator_inter_support]
  simp [Set.inter_def, and_comm]

name: probEvent_eq_tsum_subtype_support_ite
statement:
lemma probEvent_eq_tsum_subtype_support_ite (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Pr[ p | mx] = ∑' x : support mx, if p x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite, ← tsum_subtype_eq_of_support_subset (s := support mx)]
  grind [Function.support_subset_iff]

name: probEvent_eq_sum_filter_finSupport
statement:
lemma probEvent_eq_sum_filter_finSupport [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α]
    (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Pr[ p | mx] = ∑ x ∈ (finSupport mx).filter p, Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:=
  (probEvent_eq_tsum_ite mx p).trans <|
    (tsum_eq_sum' <| by simp; tauto).trans
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl <| fun x hx ↦ if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2)

name: probEvent_eq_sum_finSupport_ite
statement:
lemma probEvent_eq_sum_finSupport_ite [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α]
    (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Pr[ p | mx] = ∑ x ∈ finSupport mx, if p x then Pr[= x | mx] else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_sum_filter_finSupport, Finset.sum_filter]

name: probEvent_ext
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite, probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]
  refine tsum_congr fun x => ?_
  split_ifs <;> grind

name: probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput
statement:
@[simp, grind =_, aesop unsafe norm]
lemma probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput (mx : m α) (x : α) :
    Pr[ (· = x) | mx] = Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  simp [probEvent_def, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton, probOutput_def,
    SPMF.apply_eq_toPMF_some]

name: probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput'
statement:
@[simp, grind =_, aesop unsafe norm]
lemma probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput' (mx : m α) (x : α) :
    Pr[ (x = ·) | mx] = Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun y => x = y) = (fun y => y = x) := funext fun _ => propext eq_comm
  rw [h]; exact probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput mx x

name: probFailure_def
statement:
lemma probFailure_def [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) :
    Pr[⊥ | mx] = (𝒮[mx]).run none
proof: := rfl

name: probOutput_evalSPMF
statement:
@[simp]
lemma probOutput_evalSPMF [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) (x : α) :
    Pr[= x | 𝒮[mx]] = Pr[= x | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probOutput_def, probOutput_def, evalSPMF_id]

name: probEvent_evalSPMF
statement:
@[simp]
lemma probEvent_evalSPMF [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) :
    Pr[p | 𝒮[mx]] = Pr[p | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_def, probEvent_def, evalSPMF_id]

name: probFailure_evalSPMF
statement:
@[simp]
lemma probFailure_evalSPMF [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) :
    Pr[⊥ | 𝒮[mx]] = Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [probFailure_def, probFailure_def, evalSPMF_id]

name: evalSPMF_cast
statement:
@[simp] 
lemma evalSPMF_cast {m} [Monad m] [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (h : α = β) (mx : m α) :
    𝒮[cast (congrArg m h) mx] =
      cast (congrArg SPMF h) (𝒮[mx])
proof:
:= by
  induction h; rfl

name: evalSPMF_ext
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_ext {m n} [Monad m] [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [Monad n] [MonadLiftT n SPMF]
    {mx : m α} {mx' : n α} (h : ∀ x, Pr[= x | mx] = Pr[= x | mx']) : 𝒮[mx] = 𝒮[mx']
proof:
:= by
  apply SPMF.ext
  intro x
  simpa only [probOutput_def] using h x

name: evalSPMF_ext_iff
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_ext_iff {m n} [Monad m] [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [Monad n] [MonadLiftT n SPMF]
    {mx : m α} {mx' : n α} : 𝒮[mx] = 𝒮[mx'] ↔ ∀ x, Pr[= x | mx] = Pr[= x | mx']
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, evalSPMF_ext⟩
  simp [probOutput_def, h]

name: evalSPMF_eq_liftM_iff
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma evalSPMF_eq_liftM_iff [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) (p : PMF α) :
    𝒮[mx] = liftM p ↔ ∀ x, Pr[= x | mx] = p x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · simp [probOutput_def, h]
  · simpa [SPMF.eq_liftM_iff_forall, probOutput_def] using h

name: evalSPMF_eq_mk_iff
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma evalSPMF_eq_mk_iff [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) (p : PMF (Option α)) :
    𝒮[mx] = SPMF.mk p ↔ ∀ x, Pr[= x | mx] = p (some x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    rw [probOutput_def, h]
    rfl
  · intro h
    apply SPMF.ext
    intro x
    change (evalSPMF mx) x = p (some x)
    simpa only [probOutput_def] using h x

name: evalSPMF_eq_liftM
proof: := by aesop

name: evalSPMF_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_apply_eq_zero_iff [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [MonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m] (mx : m α) (x : Option α) :
    (𝒮[mx]).run x = 0 ↔ x.rec (Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0) (· ∉ support mx)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | none => simp [probFailure_def]
  | some y => simp [OptionT.run, mem_support_iff_evalSPMF_apply_ne_zero,
      SPMF.apply_eq_toPMF_some, SPMF.toPMF]

name: evalSPMF_apply_eq_zero_iff'
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_apply_eq_zero_iff' [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [MonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m] [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] (mx : m α)
    (x : Option α) : (𝒮[mx]).run x = 0 ↔ x.rec (Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0) (· ∉ finSupport mx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalSPMF_apply_eq_zero_iff]
  grind

name: evalSPMF_dite
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalSPMF_dite [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : p → m α) (mx' : ¬p → m α) :
    𝒮[if h : p then mx h else mx' h] = if h : p then 𝒮[mx h] else 𝒮[mx' h]
proof:

name: probOutput_dite
statement:
@[simp] lemma probOutput_dite [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (x : α) (mx : p → m α) (mx' : ¬p → m α) :
    Pr[= x | if h : p then mx h else mx' h] =
      if h : p then Pr[= x | mx h] else Pr[= x | mx' h]
proof:
:= by
  split <;> rfl

name: probFailure_dite
statement:

    Pr[⊥ | if h : p then mx h else mx' h] =
      if h : p then Pr[⊥ | mx h] else Pr[⊥ | mx' h]
proof:
:= by
  split <;> rfl

name: probEvent_dite
statement:
@[simp] lemma probEvent_dite [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : p → m α) (mx' : ¬p → m α) (q : α → Prop) :

name: evalSPMF_eqRec
statement:
lemma evalSPMF_eqRec [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (h : α = β) (mx : m α) :
    𝒮[(h ▸ mx : m β)] = h ▸ 𝒮[mx]
proof: := by grind

name: probOutput_eqRec
statement:
lemma probOutput_eqRec [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (h : α = β) (mx : m α) (y : β) :
    Pr[= y | h ▸ mx] = Pr[= h ▸ y | mx]
proof: := by induction h; rfl

name: probFailure_eqRec
statement:
@[simp] lemma probFailure_eqRec [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (h : α = β) (mx : m α) :
    Pr[⊥ | h ▸ mx] = Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof: := by induction h; rfl

name: probEvent_eqRec
statement:
lemma probEvent_eqRec [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (h : α = β) (mx : m α) (q : β → Prop) :
    Pr[ q | h ▸ mx] = Pr[ fun x ↦ q (h ▸ x) | mx]
proof: := by induction h; rfl

name: probOutput_true_eq_probEvent
statement:
lemma probOutput_true_eq_probEvent {α} {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m]
    [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [LawfulMonadLiftT m SPMF]
    (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) : Pr{let x ← mx}[p x] = Pr[ p | mx]
proof:
:= by
  simp [probEvent_eq_tsum_indicator, probOutput_def, evalSPMF, map_eq_bind_pure_comp]

lemma tsum_probOutput_add_probFailure [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) :

proof:

  aesop (rule_sets := [UnfoldEvalDist])

statement:
lemma probFailure_add_tsum_probOutput [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) :

proof:
:= by
  aesop (rule_sets := [UnfoldEvalDist])

statement:
@[simp, grind .] lemma probOutput_le_one :
    Pr[= x | mx] ≤ 1
proof: := by rw [probOutput_def]; exact PMF.coe_le_one (𝒮[mx]) x

name: probOutput_ne_top
statement:
lemma probOutput_ne_top :
    Pr[= x | mx] ≠ ∞

statement:

name: not_one_lt_probOutput
statement:
@[simp, grind .] lemma not_one_lt_probOutput :

name: tsum_probOutput_le_one
statement: lemma tsum_probOutput_le_one : ∑' x : α, Pr[= x | mx] ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  le_of_le_of_eq (le_add_self) (probFailure_add_tsum_probOutput mx)

name: tsum_probOutput_ne_top
statement: lemma tsum_probOutput_ne_top : ∑' x : α, Pr[= x | mx] ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  ne_top_of_le_ne_top one_ne_top tsum_probOutput_le_one

name: probEvent_le_one
statement: @[simp, grind .] lemma probEvent_le_one : Pr[ p | mx] ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [probEvent_def, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
  refine le_of_le_of_eq (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum ?_) ((𝒮[mx]).tsum_coe)
  exact Set.indicator_le_self (some '' {x | p x}) _

name: probEvent_ne_top
statement:
lemma probEvent_ne_top :
    Pr[ p | mx] ≠ ∞
proof: := ne_top_of_le_ne_top one_ne_top probEvent_le_one

name: probEvent_lt_top
statement:
@[simp, grind .] lemma probEvent_lt_top :
    Pr[ p | mx] < ∞

name: not_one_lt_probEvent
statement:
@[simp, grind .] lemma not_one_lt_probEvent :
    ¬ 1 < Pr[ p | mx]
proof: := not_lt.2 probEvent_le_one

name: probFailure_le_one
statement:

name: probFailure_lt_top
statement:
@[simp, grind .] lemma probFailure_lt_top :

name: not_one_lt_probFailure
statement:
@[simp, grind .] lemma not_one_lt_probFailure :

statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma one_le_probOutput_iff [MonadLiftT m SPMF] : 1 ≤ Pr[= x | mx] ↔ Pr[= x | mx] = 1

name: one_le_probEvent_iff
statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [← probEvent_eq_eq_probOutput]
  simp [probOutput_def, probFailure_def, SPMF.apply_eq_toPMF_some, PMF.apply_eq_one_iff,
    Set.ext_iff, Option.forall, mem_support_iff_evalSPMF_apply_ne_zero]

name: one_eq_probOutput_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, probOutput_eq_one_iff]

name: probOutput_eq_one_iff'
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probOutput_eq_one_iff' [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :
    Pr[= x | mx] = 1 ↔ Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0 ∧ finSupport mx = {x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [probOutput_eq_one_iff, finSupport_eq_iff_support_eq_coe, Finset.coe_singleton]

name: one_eq_probOutput_iff'
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma one_eq_probOutput_iff' [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :
    1 = Pr[= x | mx] ↔ Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0 ∧ finSupport mx = {x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, probOutput_eq_one_iff']

name: probOutput_eq_one_of_support_subset_singleton
statement:
lemma probOutput_eq_one_of_support_subset_singleton [MonadLiftT m SPMF] [MonadLiftT m SetM]
    [EvalDistCompatible m]
    (hnf : Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0) (huniq : ∀ y ∈ support mx, y = x) :
    Pr[= x | mx] = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hnf, tsum_eq_single (f := (Pr[= · | mx])) x
    fun y hy ↦ (probOutput_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr fun hmem ↦ hy (huniq y hmem)]
    using probFailure_add_tsum_probOutput mx

name: tsum_probOutput_eq_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tsum_probOutput_eq_sub (mx : m α) :
    ∑' x : α, Pr[= x | mx] = 1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq probFailure_ne_top (tsum_probOutput_add_probFailure mx)

name: tsum_probOutput_eq_one'
statement:
lemma tsum_probOutput_eq_one' {mx : m α} (h : Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0) :

name: tsum_support_probOutput_eq_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tsum_support_probOutput_eq_sub [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m] (mx : m α) :
    ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] = 1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsum_subtype_eq_of_support_subset] <;> simp

name: tsum_support_probOutput_eq_one'
statement:
lemma tsum_support_probOutput_eq_one' [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]

name: sum_probOutput_eq_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sum_probOutput_eq_sub [Fintype α] (mx : m α) :
    ∑ x : α, Pr[= x | mx] = 1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_fintype (L := .unconditional _), tsum_probOutput_eq_sub]

name: sum_probOutput_eq_one

name: sum_finSupport_probOutput_eq_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sum_finSupport_probOutput_eq_sub [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]

name: sum_finSupport_probOutput_eq_one
statement:
lemma sum_finSupport_probOutput_eq_one [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]

statement:
@[grind =]
lemma probFailure_eq_sub_tsum [MonadLiftT m SPMF] (mx : m α) :

proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq (ne_top_of_le_ne_top one_ne_top tsum_probOutput_le_one)

lemma probFailure_of_liftM_PMF (mx : m α) : Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0

lemma tsum_support_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    (mx : m α) : ∑' x : support mx, Pr[= x | mx] = 1
proof: := by simp

name: sum_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF

lemma sum_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF [Fintype α] (mx : m α) :
    ∑ x : α, Pr[= x | mx] = 1
proof: := by simp

name: sum_finSupport_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF
statement:
lemma sum_finSupport_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] (mx : m α) :
    ∑ x ∈ finSupport mx, Pr[= x | mx] = 1

name: finSupport_nonempty_of_liftM_PMF
statement:
lemma finSupport_nonempty_of_liftM_PMF [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] (mx : m α) :
    (finSupport mx).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hsum := sum_finSupport_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF (m := m) mx
  rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h, Finset.sum_empty] at hsum
  exact zero_ne_one hsum

name: probOutput_eq_inv_finSupport_card_of_liftM_PMF
statement:
lemma probOutput_eq_inv_finSupport_card_of_liftM_PMF [MonadLiftT m SetM] [EvalDistCompatible m]
    [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] {mx : m α} {c : ENNReal}
    (hconst : ∀ x ∈ support mx, Pr[= x | mx] = c) :
    c = 1 / (finSupport mx).card
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_finSupport_probOutput_of_liftM_PMF (m := m) mx
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => hconst x (mem_support_of_mem_finSupport hx),
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at h
  simpa using ENNReal.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h

name: probEvent_compl
statement:
lemma probEvent_compl (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) :
    Pr[ p | mx] + Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] = 1 - Pr[⊥ | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred p
  simp only [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite, ← ENNReal.tsum_add, ← tsum_probOutput_eq_sub]
  exact tsum_congr fun x => by split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: probEvent_or_le
statement:
lemma probEvent_or_le (mx : m α) (p q : α → Prop) :
    Pr[ fun x => p x ∨ q x | mx] ≤ Pr[ p | mx] + Pr[ q | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred p; have := Classical.decPred q
  simp only [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hp : p x <;> by_cases hq : q x <;> simp [hp, hq]

name: probEvent_le_tsum_probOutput_mul_cost
statement:
lemma probEvent_le_tsum_probOutput_mul_cost (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) (c : α → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, p x → 1 ≤ c x) :
    Pr[ p | mx] ≤ ∑' x : α, Pr[= x | mx] * c x
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred p
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite mx p]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  split_ifs with hp
  · calc Pr[= x | mx] = Pr[= x | mx] * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ Pr[= x | mx] * c x := by gcongr; exact hc x hp
  · exact zero_le

name: probEvent_le_tsum_probOutput_mul_cost_of_mem_support
statement:
lemma probEvent_le_tsum_probOutput_mul_cost_of_mem_support
    (mx : m α) (p : α → Prop) (c : α → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x → 1 ≤ c x) :
    Pr[ p | mx] ≤ ∑' x : α, Pr[= x | mx] * c x
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred p
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite mx p]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
  · split_ifs with hp
    · calc Pr[= x | mx] = Pr[= x | mx] * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ Pr[= x | mx] * c x := by
              gcongr
              exact hc x hx hp
    · exact zero_le
  · rw [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx]
    simp

name: probEvent_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma probEvent_mono (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x → q x) : Pr[ p | mx] ≤ Pr[ q | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred p; have := Classical.decPred q
  simp only [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  split_ifs with hp hq <;>
    first
    | rfl
    | exact zero_le
    | exact le_of_eq (probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support fun hx => hq (h x hx hp))

name: probEvent_mono'
statement:
lemma probEvent_mono' [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ finSupport mx, p x → q x) : Pr[ p | mx] ≤ Pr[ q | mx]
proof:
:=
  probEvent_mono (fun x hx hpx => h x (mem_finSupport_of_mem_support hx) hpx)

name: probEvent_mono''
statement:
@[gcongr low]
lemma probEvent_mono'' (h : ∀ x, p x → q x) : Pr[ p | mx] ≤ Pr[ q | mx]
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decPred p
  have := Classical.decPred q
  simp only [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hp : p x <;> by_cases hq : q x <;> simp_all

name: probEvent_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp low]
lemma probEvent_eq_one_iff :
    Pr[ p | mx] = 1 ↔ Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (∀ x ∈ support mx, p x) ↔ Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] = 0 by
    simp [probEvent_eq_zero_iff]]
  have hadd : Pr[ p | mx] + (Pr[ fun x => ¬p x | mx] + Pr[⊥ | mx]) = 1 := by
    rw [← add_assoc, probEvent_compl mx p, tsub_add_cancel_of_le probFailure_le_one]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨hf, hb⟩ => by simpa [hf, hb] using hadd⟩
  rw [h] at hadd
  exact and_comm.1 (add_eq_zero.1 (by simpa using hadd))

name: probOutput_eq_one_iff_forall
statement:
lemma probOutput_eq_one_iff_forall (mx : m α) (x : α) :
    Pr[= x | mx] = 1 ↔ Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0 ∧ ∀ y ∈ support mx, y = x
proof:

name: one_eq_probEvent_iff
statement:

lemma one_eq_probEvent_iff :
    1 = Pr[ p | mx] ↔ Pr[⊥ | mx] = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ support mx, p x

name: probEvent_eq_one_iff'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma probEvent_eq_one_iff' [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :

name: one_eq_probEvent_iff'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_eq_probEvent_iff' [HasEvalFinset m] [DecidableEq α] :

name: mem_support_iff_of_evalSPMF_eq

lemma mem_support_iff_of_evalSPMF_eq {m n} [Monad m] [MonadLiftT m SPMF]

name: mem_finSupport_iff_of_evalSPMF_eq

lemma mem_finSupport_iff_of_evalSPMF_eq {m n} [Monad m] [MonadLiftT m SPMF]

name: indicator_objective_eq_probEvent
statement:
lemma indicator_objective_eq_probEvent (mx : m (α × β)) (R : α → β → Prop) :
    (∑' z, Pr[= z | mx] * (if R z.1 z.2 then 1 else 0)) = Pr[ fun z => R z.1 z.2 | mx]

:= by
  rw [probEvent_eq_tsum_ite]

name: expectedValue_def
statement:
theorem expectedValue_def (mx : m α) (g : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectedValue mx g = ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * g x
proof: := rfl

name: expectedValue_mono
statement:
@[gcongr low]
theorem expectedValue_mono (mx : m α) {g h : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hgh : ∀ x, g x ≤ h x) :
    expectedValue mx g ≤ expectedValue mx h
proof:
:=
  ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => mul_le_mul' le_rfl (hgh x)

name: expectedValue_le_of_le
statement:
theorem expectedValue_le_of_le (mx : m α) {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} {c : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x, g x ≤ c) :
    expectedValue mx g ≤ c
proof:
:=
  (expectedValue_mono mx h).trans <| by
    rw [expectedValue, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left zero_le tsum_probOutput_le_one

name: expectedValue_add
statement:
theorem expectedValue_add (mx : m α) (g h : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectedValue mx (fun x => g x + h x) = expectedValue mx g + expectedValue mx h
proof:

  simp only [expectedValue, mul_add]
  exact ENNReal.tsum_add

name: expectedValue_ite_one
statement:

    expectedValue mx (fun x => if p x then 1 else 0) = Pr[ p | mx]
proof:

  simp only [expectedValue_def, probEvent_eq_tsum_ite, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: expectedValue_mul_const
statement:

    expectedValue mx (fun x => g x * c) = expectedValue mx g * c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expectedValue_def, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]

name: expectedValue_mono_of_support
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ support mx
  · exact mul_le_mul' le_rfl (hgh x hx)
  · simp [probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support hx]

name: expectedValue_le_of_support
statement:
theorem expectedValue_le_of_support {mx : m α} {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} {c : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ support mx, g x ≤ c) : expectedValue mx g ≤ c
proof:
:=
  (expectedValue_mono_of_support h).trans (expectedValue_le_of_le mx fun _ => le_rfl)

name: expectedValue_congr_of_support
statement:
theorem expectedValue_congr_of_support {mx : m α} {g h : α → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ support mx, g x = h x) : expectedValue mx g = expectedValue mx h
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (expectedValue_mono_of_support fun x hx => (hgh x hx).le)
    (expectedValue_mono_of_support fun x hx => (hgh x hx).ge)

name: tsum_probOutput_mul_le_of_le
statement:
lemma tsum_probOutput_mul_le_of_le (mx : m α) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} {c : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ c) :
    ∑' x, Pr[= x | mx] * f x ≤ c
proof:

  OracleComp.EvalDist.expectedValue_le_of_le mx h

name: evalDist_apply
statement:
theorem evalDist_apply (mx : m α) {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :

proof:

    DiscreteEvalDistCompatible.lintegral_evalDist mx (measurable_one.indicator hs),
    probEvent_eq_tsum_indicator]
  exact tsum_congr fun x => by by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [hx]

name: evalDist_bind
statement:
theorem evalDist_bind {m : Type u → Type v} [Monad m] [EvalDistSemantics m]
    [LawfulEvalDistSemantics m] {α β : Type u} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (mx : m α) (f : α → m β) (hf : Measurable fun x => 𝒟[f x]) :
    𝒟[mx >>= f] = Measure.bind 𝒟[mx] fun x => 𝒟[f x]
proof:
:=

name: evalDist_bind_of_discrete

theorem evalDist_bind_of_discrete {m : Type u → Type v} [Monad m] [EvalDistSemantics m]
    [LawfulEvalDistSemantics m] {α β : Type u} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [DiscreteMeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] (mx : m α) (f : α → m β) :

name: evalDist_map
statement:
theorem evalDist_map {m : Type u → Type v} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] [EvalDistSemantics m]
    [LawfulEvalDistSemantics m] {α β : Type u} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (mx : m α) {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) : 𝒟[f <$> mx] = 𝒟[mx].map f
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Measurable fun x => 𝒟[(pure (f x) : m β)] := by
    simp only [evalDist_pure]
    exact Measure.measurable_dirac.comp hf
  rw [map_eq_bind_pure_comp, evalDist_bind mx (pure ∘ f) hd]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, evalDist_pure]
  exact Measure.bind_dirac_eq_map 𝒟[mx] hf

    [LawfulEvalDistSemantics m] {α β : Type u} [MeasurableSpace α] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] (mx : m α) (f : α → m β) {g : β → ENNReal} (hg : Measurable g) :
